newsitem.title: POLAND: FIAT LAUNCHES SIENA MODEL IN EUROPE.
newsitem.headline: FIAT LAUNCHES SIENA MODEL IN EUROPE.

text.p: Italy's Fiat SpA launched on Thursday its compact Siena model for the first time in Europe at an automotive fair in the Polish city of Poznan.
The global launch of the car was held early this month in Argentina where it has been produced since December. Poland will be the only production centre of the model for Europe.
Carlo Poggi, commercial director of Fiat Auto Poland, the carmaker's Polish unit, told a news conference the company planned to make up to 50,000 Sienas at its Bielsko-Biala plant in southern Poland.
Fiat's Argentinian plan is expected to reach an output of 120,000 Sienas next year.
Poggi said Fiat planned to invest 210 million zlotys over 1997-1998 in the production of the new model in the Bielsko-Biala plant.
Fiat now manufactures in Poland its subcompact Cinquecento model and 126 minicar.

Massimo Gentilini, the head of Fiat Auto Poland, also present, told the news conference the company expected to maintain this year its close to 40 percent market share and planned to invest 800 million zlotys in 1997-2002.
